name: Abner Moss
want: keep the coaches running on time and never be burned out again
secret: On the day of the first raid he hid in the root cellar while the station hands fought, and two of them died.
voice: Gruff and talkative, a story for everything.
description: Was here when the station burned last year; sleeps with a rifle and has opinions about everybody.
appearance: Stocky and bald, a powder-burned beard, suspenders and a Henry rifle.
